ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What label is pointing to the Rachis?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a line schematic diagram of a compound leaf/leaf-like structure, with multiple small leaflets arranged along a central main axis. There are multiple letter labels and leader lines on the right, among which the leader line of F points to the lower central axis/stalk-like part. Reasoning: rachis refers to the central main axis that bears leaflets in a compound leaf or pinnate leaf. What F points to in the figure is exactly the lower part of this central main axis, therefore the label pointing to Rachis is F.
